**Franchise:** Doctor Who  
**Strategy:** Swarm · **Target roster:** 11 robots

**Direction:** A faction-based army of converted cyborgs, distinct from the existing Dalek stable. Select one source era and recognizable Cyberman construction before production. [Official Cybermen profile](https://www.doctorwho.tv/characters/cybermen).

**Production edition:** Doctor Who — 2006 Cybus Cybermen, one Controller, one Leader and nine standard units.  
**Catalogue key:** `cyberman-conversion-works`
purchasing_plan: Open with slots 1–3; recruit 4 through 11 in slot order. Fund each complete stage-0 loadout and the necessary roster/storage expansion before recruitment. Prioritise the full roster, then stage-1 equipment in slot order. No weapon refinement purchases.
